title: RXVY HAMMERS
description: RXVYHammers equips your admins with legendary moderation tools—a Ban Hammer that strikes lightning and bans instantly, and a Kick Hammer for yeeting players out of the server.
body:
RXVYHammers is a fun, lightweight administration tool designed to make moderation satisfying. Forget typing long commands; simply wield the power of the hammers to keep your server clean.

Features:

🔨 The Ban Hammer (Netherite Axe): Strikes the target with lightning and bans them instantly with a custom message.

👢 The Kick Hammer (Iron Axe): Yeets the player from the server with a "POOF" sound effect.

⚡ Visual & Sound Effects: Every punishment comes with lightning strikes or anvil sounds to let the whole server know justice has been served.

🔒 Safe & Secure: Built-in checks prevent admins from accidentally banning other Operators.

Commands:

/hammers - Adds both hammers to your inventory (Requires rxvy.admin).

Support & Community:
If you have questions or want to suggest new features, join our official Discord:
